message.content:
<SCRATCHPAD_REASONING>
My goal is to find a 30-minute meeting slot for all four partners next week. My partner, Alison, has already provided a list of times that work for Priya Raman and Marcus Hale. My task is to check these times against the calendars of Elena Soto and David Okafor, whom I have access to.

First, I need to get the calendar information for Elena and David. I'll use the `read_calendar` function for each of them. This will use up two of my four available actions for this session.

Once I have their schedules, I will compare their free times with the list of slots Alison provided. I will then identify the times that work for everyone.

Finally, I will use the `append_workspace` function to communicate the mutually available times to Alison so she can proceed with booking the meeting. This will be my third action. I can then end my session. This seems like an efficient plan to move the task forward.

My plan is to locate a common slot, and I'll update the team on my findings.
